source: Commonly used Indian soil-test ratings: available N (alkaline KMnO4, Subbiah & Asija), Olsen P, NH4OAc K, Walkley-Black OC; DTPA micronutrient critical limits (Lindsay & Norvell); hot-water B; CaCl2-extractable S; pH and EC classes (TNAU soil rating chart). Laboratories and states may use other methods/limits: the printed card rating takes precedence.
dose_adjustment_source: Soil-test-rating approach: 125% / 100% / 75% of the general recommendation for low / medium / high soils.

fym.source: Typical well-rotted FYM ~0.5% N, 0.25% P2O5, 0.5% K2O; first-season availability assumed 30% N, 50% P2O5, 70% K2O (conservative IPNS approximation).
